name: stay•safe CAPD - VR Demo USA
summary:
This app is for United States only. 

The stay•safe® CAPD - Virtual Reality Demo is a digital learning tool that offers support to clinics and nephrologists in creating awareness of the Continuous Ambulatory Peritoneal Dialysis (CAPD) therapy. 

Including:

- Virtual step-by-step demonstration of a stay•safe® CAPD exchange.
- An immersive 3D environment that supports learning by doing.
- Support for different learning styles with a mix of visual, auditory, and interactive elements.
